---
title: Training Hub
description: Manage the step-by-step training videos vendors watch inside the vendor app, and track likes, plays and comments.
---

## Overview

**Sidebar:** Vendors → Comms → **Training Hub** (`/vendors/training`)

The **Vendor Training Hub** holds the step-by-step videos vendors watch inside the app. Videos are grouped by **Step**; vendors watch them in step order, and several videos can share a step.

## What the screen shows

Videos are grouped under **Step 1, Step 2, …** headings (with a video count per step). Each video card shows:

| Element | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Player | Inline video preview. |
| Title & description | As entered when the video was added. |
| Likes | Count — click to **see who liked it**. |
| Views | Unique vendors who watched, with total plays in brackets (e.g. "5 (16)" = 5 vendors watched · 16 plays). |
| Comments | Count — click to **read comments**. The comments dialog lists each comment with the commenter, role/shop and date, and a delete icon to remove a comment. |
| Status | **Active** / Inactive badge with an on/off switch. |
| ⋮ menu | **Edit** or **Delete**. |

## Filters & search

- **Search by title or description**.
- **Status** — All statuses, Active only, Inactive only.
- Total video count is shown next to the filters.

## Add / Edit video

Click **Add Video** (top right) or **Edit** from a card's ⋮ menu.

| Field | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| **Video** | Drag and drop or **Browse Files**. MP4, WebM or MOV · max 300 MB · up to 10 minutes. |
| **Title** | e.g. "How to accept a pickup". |
| **Description** | What this video covers. |
| **Step** | Number. Vendors watch videos in step order; several videos may share a step. |
| **Status** | "Visible to vendors" switch. |

<Callout kind="tip">
Use the play counts and comments to spot steps vendors rewatch or ask questions about — those usually need a clearer video.
</Callout>
